locations.page_title: San Francisco Mobile IV Therapy | The IV Doc

items.name: Dehydration Relief
items.description: Is a lack of hydration making you feel fatigued and lightheaded? Our Dehydration Relief IV therapy will rehydrate and rejuvenate you with fluid and electrolytes to quickly improve how you feel.

items.name: Hangover Relief - Basic
items.description: Feeling run-down from a late night out? Our Hangover Relief - Basic IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip with choice of 1 medication to quickly treat any of the following conditions: pain/headache, nausea, or heartburn (reflux).

items.name: Hangover Relief - Advanced
items.description: *most popular service*

items.name: Hangover Relief - Supreme
items.description: Did you go completely overboard and medications alone aren't enough? Our Hangover Relief - Supreme IV therapy is the ultimate hangover IV drip and vitamin infusion, packed with 3 medications, Vitamin B12, and Glutathione for extra detox power.

items.name: Energy Boost
items.description: Physically and mentally struggling to get through the day? Our Energy Boost IV therapy will give you the kickstart you need to feel reenergized with a specially designed IV infusion of B vitamins, including Vitamins B12 and B Complex.

items.name: Myers Cocktail
items.description: Looking for "the classic" IV therapy that has long been used to treat chronic fatigue, dehydration, weakened immunity, and to support overall health and wellness? Our Myers Cocktail IV therapy is just your answer.

items.name: Stomach Bug Relief
items.description: Stomach Bug Relief therapy is the ultimate IV drip treatment for combating symptoms of the Stomach Bug or Winter Vomiting Bug. With specialized medication to treat nausea, an anti-inflammatory, and a pro-motility agent to aid in fast recovery.

items.name: Allergy Relief
items.description: Are allergies taking over your life? The IV Doc's Allergy Relief IV drip, with immune-boosting Magnesium, Zinc, and Vitamin C, and a choice of anti-histamine or anti-inflammatory medication, may provide rapid relief from bothersome symptoms.

items.name: Cyclic Vomiting Relief
items.description: CVS & CHS Symptom Treatment

items.name: Weight Loss Med Nausea Relief
items.description: Struggling with nausea and vomiting from popular weight loss medications and looking for fast relief? Our Weight Loss Med Nausea Relief IV has specialized medication to treat nausea, an anti-inflammatory, and a pro-motility agent to aid in fast recovery.

items.name: Cold & Flu Relief
items.description: Our Cold & Flu Relief IV therapy is a specially tailored IV drip of medications, vitamins, and electrolytes meant to treat the symptoms of Cold & Flu and aid in fast recovery! It includes Vitamin C, a multi-vitamin, anti-nausea & anti-inflammatory meds.

items.name: Immunity Boost
items.description: Looking to turbocharge your immune system to help fight off infection and raise your energy level? Our Immunity Boost IV therapy is a vitamin and antioxidant infusion containing Vitamin C, B complex, B12, a multi-vitamin, and Glutathione.

items.name: Neuro Boost
items.description: Seeking to revitalize your nervous system? Our Neuro Boost IV therapy is a specially designed infusion of Glutathione, Taurine, Magnesium, Vitamin B12, and Vitamin B Complex meant to help empower your mind and body.

items.name: Metabolism Boost
items.description: IV Therapy & IM Injection

items.name: Athletic Boost
items.description: Are you ready to take your athletic performance to the next level? Our Athletic Boost IV therapy is packed with Magnesium, Vitamin B12, Zinc, Lysine, Ornithine, Arginine & Citrulline to help you reach your peak potential.

items.name: Food Poisoning Relief
items.description: Get rapid food poisoning relief in the comfort and privacy of your home or hotel room. Our Food Poisoning IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip of medications to treat the symptoms of food poisoning, including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever.

items.name: Migraine Relief
items.description: Tired of debilitating migraines disrupting your life? Our Migraine Relief IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip meant to provide fast migraine relief with a custom infusion of IV fluids, electrolytes, and medications.

items.name: Stress Relief

items.name: Jet Lag Relief

items.description: Is a lack of hydration making you feel fatigued and lightheaded? Our Dehydration Relief IV therapy will rehydrate and rejuvenate you with fluid and electrolytes to quickly improve how you feel.

items.name: Hangover Relief - Basic
items.description: Feeling run-down from a late night out? Our Hangover Relief - Basic IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip with choice of 1 medication to quickly treat any of the following conditions: pain/headache, nausea, or heartburn (reflux).

items.name: Hangover Relief - Advanced
items.description: *most popular service*

items.name: Hangover Relief - Supreme
items.description: Did you go completely overboard and medications alone aren't enough? Our Hangover Relief - Supreme IV therapy is the ultimate hangover IV drip and vitamin infusion, packed with 3 medications, Vitamin B12, and Glutathione for extra detox power.

items.name: Energy Boost
items.description: Physically and mentally struggling to get through the day? Our Energy Boost IV therapy will give you the kickstart you need to feel reenergized with a specially designed IV infusion of B vitamins, including Vitamins B12 and B Complex.

items.name: Myers Cocktail
items.description: Looking for "the classic" IV therapy that has long been used to treat chronic fatigue, dehydration, weakened immunity, and to support overall health and wellness? Our Myers Cocktail IV therapy is just your answer.

items.name: Stomach Bug Relief
items.description: Stomach Bug Relief therapy is the ultimate IV drip treatment for combating symptoms of the Stomach Bug or Winter Vomiting Bug. With specialized medication to treat nausea, an anti-inflammatory, and a pro-motility agent to aid in fast recovery.

items.name: Allergy Relief
items.description: Are allergies taking over your life? The IV Doc's Allergy Relief IV drip, with immune-boosting Magnesium, Zinc, and Vitamin C, and a choice of anti-histamine or anti-inflammatory medication, may provide rapid relief from bothersome symptoms.

items.name: Cyclic Vomiting Relief
items.description: CVS & CHS Symptom Treatment

items.name: Weight Loss Med Nausea Relief
items.description: Struggling with nausea and vomiting from popular weight loss medications and looking for fast relief? Our Weight Loss Med Nausea Relief IV has specialized medication to treat nausea, an anti-inflammatory, and a pro-motility agent to aid in fast recovery.

items.name: Cold & Flu Relief
items.description: Our Cold & Flu Relief IV therapy is a specially tailored IV drip of medications, vitamins, and electrolytes meant to treat the symptoms of Cold & Flu and aid in fast recovery! It includes Vitamin C, a multi-vitamin, anti-nausea & anti-inflammatory meds.

items.name: Immunity Boost
items.description: Looking to turbocharge your immune system to help fight off infection and raise your energy level? Our Immunity Boost IV therapy is a vitamin and antioxidant infusion containing Vitamin C, B complex, B12, a multi-vitamin, and Glutathione.

items.name: Neuro Boost
items.description: Seeking to revitalize your nervous system? Our Neuro Boost IV therapy is a specially designed infusion of Glutathione, Taurine, Magnesium, Vitamin B12, and Vitamin B Complex meant to help empower your mind and body.

items.name: Metabolism Boost
items.description: IV Therapy & IM Injection

items.name: Athletic Boost
items.description: Are you ready to take your athletic performance to the next level? Our Athletic Boost IV therapy is packed with Magnesium, Vitamin B12, Zinc, Lysine, Ornithine, Arginine & Citrulline to help you reach your peak potential.

items.name: Food Poisoning Relief
items.description: Get rapid food poisoning relief in the comfort and privacy of your home or hotel room. Our Food Poisoning IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip of medications to treat the symptoms of food poisoning, including nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever.

items.name: Migraine Relief
items.description: Tired of debilitating migraines disrupting your life? Our Migraine Relief IV therapy is a specially designed IV drip meant to provide fast migraine relief with a custom infusion of IV fluids, electrolytes, and medications.

items.name: Stress Relief
items.description: Got a lot on your mind? Our Stress Relief IV therapy may help to quickly calm your nerves and de-stress with a potent blend of vitamins, amino acids, and nutrients, including Magnesium, Taurine, Vitamin B12, and Vitamin B Complex.

items.name: Jet Lag Relief
items.description: If you travel long distances for business or pleasure and your body is not feeling right, our Jet Lag Relief IV therapy includes medication and vitamins that will help put you back on track feeling re-energized, including Vitamin B12 and a multi-vitamin.

items.name: Monthly Cycle Relief
items.description: Suffering from the pain of cramps, headache, and other discomforting symptoms of your monthly cycle? Our Monthly Cycle Relief IV therapy is packed with Vitamin B12, Vitamin B Complex, and an anti-inflammatory medication to help make you feel better fast.

items.name: Morning Sickness Relief
items.description: Are you tired of feeling nauseous and exhausted due to morning sickness? With a combination of vitamins and an anti-nausea medication, our Morning Sickness Relief IV can alleviate your symptoms and leave you feeling energized and refreshed.

items.name: Beautify
items.description: Look and feel your best with healthy skin and hair prior to your event or night out. Our Beautify IV therapy is loaded with a custom blend of B vitamins, a multi-vitamin, an anti-inflammatory, and electrolytes that will rehydrate, replenish, and restore.

items.name: Antioxidant
items.description: Boost your immune system with a vitamin infusion containing a custom blend of powerful anti-oxidizing agents to aid in neutralizing harmful free radicals. Our Antioxidant IV therapy includes Vitamin C, Glutathione, a multi-vitamin, and electrolytes.
